title.zh: 在哥打巴托省桑托斯将军城市镇设立急诊医院，名称为桑托斯将军城急诊医院，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of General Santos, Province of Cotabato, to be Known as the General Santos Emergency Hospital, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of General Santos, Province of Cotabato, to be Known as the General Santos Emergency Hospital, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Cấp cứu tại Đô thị General Santos, Tỉnh Cotabato với tên gọi General Santos Emergency Hospital, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน ในเทศบาล General Santos จังหวัด Cotabato ในชื่อ General Santos Emergency Hospital และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Hospital Kecemasan di Perbandaran General Santos, Wilayah Cotabato dengan nama General Santos Emergency Hospital, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, an emergency hospital in the Municipality of General Santos, Province of Cotabato, to be known as the General Santos Emergency Hospital. The site for the said hospital shall be determined by the Municipal Council of the Municipality of General Santos in consultation with the Director of Medical Services.
The Secretary of Health shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry into effect the purpose of this Act.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the said hospital for the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-one. Such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
